nextSteps.text: The agent role may not do this: do not retry or look for another route.
Tell the person which access is missing and ask whether you should have it.
Tell the agent to add the access once you decide it should have it.
End your turn: the person decides.
When the person tells you to add it, run this and show them the link it prints, where they grant the access.

body.personMessage: The agent was denied read access to payroll. If it should have it, tell the agent: it gives you a link where you grant it.
